newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes little changed, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes little changed, seen stable.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed virtually unchanged on Thursday on a lack of market-moving news and dealers said they expected narrow-range trade to continue.
The local dollar ended at T$27.497 against Wednesday's T$27.495 finish. Turnover was US$153 million.

Some foreign funds took profits in the stock market and repatriated their money at the end of the year, pressuring the Taiwan dollar lower, but some local U.S. dollar demand limited the local unit's downside.
"The market should remain this quiet for some time," said one dealer.
Dealers said they expected a narrow T$27.49-27.51 trading range for Friday.
